theme.title: Courtside Curiosities
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: In his famous one-quarter scoring explosion against Sacramento, how many points did Klay Thompson score?
questions.context: Klay Thompson · Warriors vs. Kings · January 2015
questions.note: 37 points in a single quarter, without missing a shot.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In the third quarter of that game, he scored an NBA-record 37 points for a single quarter

funFacts.text: Klay went 13-for-13 from the field in the third quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: going 13-for-13 from the field

funFacts.text: He sank nine three-pointers in that quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: including nine three-pointers

funFacts.text: He finished with 52 points and 11 threes.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Thompson scored a career-high 52 points, with 11 three-pointers

questions.prompt: The 2012–13 Heat won 27 straight. How many in a row did Barkley's Suns win during December of his 1992–93 MVP season?
questions.note: 14 straight wins during an undefeated month.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: posted a 14-game winning streak in December; the team posted a 14–0 record that month

funFacts.text: Phoenix started 7–4 before the team caught fire in December.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Suns got off to a 7–4 start to the regular season

funFacts.text: The Suns reached the All-Star break at 38–10.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: held a 38–10 record at the All-Star break

funFacts.text: Another 11-game winning streak came between March and April.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: posted an 11-game winning streak between March and April

questions.prompt: The chart shows four recent champions' win totals. How many did the 2022–23 Heat win on their way to the Finals?
questions.note: 44–38, then a run to the Finals through the play-in.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They regressed from their 53–29 record the previous season and finished with a record of 44–38

funFacts.text: Miami had to go through two play-in games to reach the playoffs.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Miami had to go through two play-in games to extend their season

funFacts.text: Miami was the only playoff team with a negative point differential.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the only team in the league to qualify for the playoffs with a negative point differential

funFacts.text: Undrafted players including Caleb Martin and Gabe Vincent supplied vital production around the established stars.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: undrafted players such as Martin, Gabe Vincent, Duncan Robinson, and Max Strus

questions.prompt: Wilt Chamberlain averaged 50.4 points in 1961–62. What did he average for the 1966–67 champion 76ers?
questions.note: 24 a game. Wilt shot less, made a league-record 68% of his shots and again led the NBA in rebounds.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: while scoring 24 points per game and once again leading the NBA in rebounds

funFacts.text: Wilt took fewer shots in 1966–67 and made a league-record 68 percent of them.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Shooting less, he made a league-record 68% of his shots

funFacts.text: Wilt also became a passer that season: his 8 assists per game set a record for centers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Wilt Chamberlain's 8 assists per game set a record for centers

funFacts.text: Philadelphia opened 1966–67 at 46–4, the best 50-game start in NBA history at the time.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 76ers started the season at 46–4, which remains the best 50-game start in the NBA history

questions.prompt: Down late in Game 2 of the 2011 Finals against LeBron's Heat, how large a deficit did Dirk's Mavericks erase to win?
questions.context: Dallas Mavericks at Miami Heat · 2011 Finals Game 2
questions.note: 15 points. Dirk hit a go-ahead three and then the winning layup to stun Miami, 95–93.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Mavs' 15-point comeback was the biggest in an NBA Finals game

funFacts.text: Dirk hit a go-ahead three with under 30 seconds left.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Dirk Nowitzki hit a 3 with 26.7 seconds left to give the Mavericks a 93–90 lead.

funFacts.text: Nowitzki delivered the winner with his injured left hand.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Nowitzki then made a driving layup with his injured left hand with 3.6 seconds left

funFacts.text: Dwyane Wade's final attempt bounced off the rim.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Dwyane Wade's potential game-winning 3 hit the back rim at the buzzer
